The component portfolio spans each of these fluid subsystems and includes solenoid control valves, check valves, relief valves, burst disks, fluid filters, regulators, manually operated service valves, machined fluid manifolds, and instrumentation including pressure transducers and RTDs. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Access Management
jobs.description_text: The Opportunity Every day, a security administrator somewhere decides who can open which door. A new nurse starts on Monday and needs the medication room but not the server closet. A contractor needs the loading dock for three weeks. Someone leaves the company at 5pm and their badge should stop working at 5:01. Multiply that by 200,000 employees across 400 sites, and you have one of the largest and least-solved logistical problems in enterprise software. Access control is Verkada's second largest business: hundreds of millions of dollars in sales, growing 40 to 60% year over year, with roughly 80 people building in this area. Access management is the pillar that decides whether all of that feels effortless or exhausting. We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own it end to end: users, identities, groups, policies, requests, access levels, and visitor access, from the moment an admin expresses intent to the moment a door opens for the right person. We do this well today. We think it can be dramatically better, through interfaces that make scale feel simple, APIs and integrations that let the system run itself, and agents that let an admin state what they want instead of clicking through configuration. You will own that as a vertical slice: web and mobile, the backend behind them, the configuration we push to door hardware, and the API and agent surfaces we expose. jobs.title: Scientist - ADA/PK
jobs.description_text: Scientist help turn well-executed laboratory work into dependable results for client studies. This role independently leads routine assay execution, applies sound technical judgment, reviews and interprets data, and works across laboratory operations, quality, and project teams to keep studies moving. You will work under general supervision, taking ownership of routine scientific activities while seeking guidance for novel or complex situations. The role offers the opportunity to contribute to study execution, scientific documentation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement in a collaborative laboratory environment. *Internal applications will be accepted until Monday, October 26th.

jobs.title: Scientist III - LC/MS (Bioanalytical)
jobs.description_text: In this hands-on, laboratory-based Scientist role, you will design, develop, and execute bioanalytical methods and experiments supporting the advancement of new therapies, with a particular focus on large-molecule LC/MS applications. You’ll spend much of your time at the bench performing method development, optimization, and GxP-compliant validation; generating and analyzing data; evaluating assay performance; and conducting targeted and untargeted analyses using liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys being in the lab, working through complex scientific problems, and seeing a method through from development to validation and execution. You’ll work across a variety of client programs and therapeutic areas, which means the science and day-to-day challenges can vary quite a bit. We’re looking for someone with strong LC/MS experience who is comfortable working in a regulated environment and understands the importance of producing accurate, high-quality data.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst - ADA/PK/Biomarkers
jobs.description_text: At BioAgilytix, Senior Analysts turn sound laboratory work into reliable results. In this role, you will execute established assays, review data, troubleshoot routine issues, and help keep studies moving on schedule. You will work with growing independence while collaborating with scientists, project teams, and quality partners. Based on your experience, technical strengths, and the needs of the hiring team, your assignments may focus on sample analysis, assay development, or a combination of laboratory projects.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst - Cell Based
jobs.description_text: At BioAgilytix, we are passionate about premier science and the impact it has on our world. Our team of highly experienced scientists and professionals deliver tailored services for supporting new medicine breakthroughs with best-in-class bioanalytical services. We are tirelessly committed to our customers by being solution-oriented and deadline-driven. . . and we are growing. Our culture is fast-paced, fun and never boring. Because we work across numerous clients and drug modalities, your career can develop rapidly. You’ll gain experience with a variety of challenges all while you enable life-changing, life-saving therapeutics to the patients who need them.
